core_obligations: Construct a Muller concurrent-track language that no Buchi higher-dimensional automaton recognizes.
Use recurrent hypercube cells and sequential replacements to preserve acceptance while changing the infinite event language.
Exhibit an omega-rational language incompatible with the finite-prefix replacement closure forced by Muller acceptance.
proof_roadmap: Muller witness and recurrent-cell replacement contradict Buchi recognition
Omega-rational witness and prefix replacement contradict Muller recognition
difficulty_reason: Unlike classical word automata, higher-dimensional Buchi and Muller conditions separate. The author uses the geometry of precubical cells to replace concurrent steps with sequential tracks while controlling infinitely recurring states; a related finite-prefix replacement yields the second strict separation. Both adjacent separations are counted together as one expressiveness hierarchy, not split into repetitive examples.
